description: Extract articulation-relevant course information from a school course catalog. Extract every course and its description when present. Do not extract prerequisites.

department.instruction: The academic department or subject area for the course, if listed.

course_code.instruction: The course code or number exactly as listed.

course_title.instruction: The official course title exactly as listed.

course_level.instruction: The course level, such as introductory, intermediate, advanced, undergraduate, or graduate, when supported by the catalog.

description.instruction: The complete official course description. Preserve the catalog wording and omit prerequisites.

credits.instruction: The number of credits or credit hours awarded for the course.

contact_hours.instruction: The total instructional or contact hours, if stated.

lecture_hours.instruction: The lecture hours, if separately stated.

lab_hours.instruction: The laboratory hours, if separately stated.

studio_hours.instruction: The studio hours, if separately stated.

delivery_mode.instruction: The delivery mode, such as in-person, online, hybrid, lecture, laboratory, or studio, if stated.

duration.instruction: The course duration, term length, meeting period, or sequence information, if stated.

learning_outcomes.instruction: The stated learning outcomes, objectives, or goals, if present. List each one separated by a semicolon.

topics.instruction: The major topics, units, concepts, or subject areas covered, if present. List each one separated by a semicolon.

competencies.instruction: The skills or competencies students are expected to develop, if present. List each one separated by a semicolon.

assignments.instruction: The named assignments, projects, or major student work, if present. List each one separated by a semicolon.

assessment_methods.instruction: The grading, assessment, or evaluation methods, if present. List each one separated by a semicolon.

required_materials.instruction: Required textbooks, readings, software, equipment, or other materials, if present. List each one separated by a semicolon.

transfer_notes.instruction: Transfer, articulation, equivalency, or comparable-course notes explicitly stated, if present. List each one separated by a semicolon.

institution.instruction: The name of the school or institution publishing this catalog.

catalog_title.instruction: The title of the catalog or course catalog document, if stated.

catalog_academic_year.instruction: The academic year, term, or catalog period stated in the document.

courses.instruction: Every individual course listed anywhere in the catalog, extracted separately. A catalog typically lists many courses; extract each one as its own entry rather than summarizing or picking a single course.
